assets.split_warning: Upstream has no train/validation partition. Before experiments group by poem identity and near-duplicate family; do not draw overlapping windows into different splits. Exact rendered-text duplicates have been removed. Collection contains no eval/test/calibration assets.

chapter_7_note: These two corpora are pretraining text, not instruction/assistant-only SFT. Chapter 7 training conversations should come from the separate behavior/SFT collection, not be mislabeled stories or poems.
split_and_quality_notes: Only upstream TRAIN file was downloaded for TinyStories; no upstream validation, evaluation prompt, benchmark, test or calibration assets.
Reserve complete story/poem families before training and tokenizer learning; a training-only pilot is not itself a held-out performance measurement.
512 English stories and 365 unique ancient Chinese poems are small educational pilots, not enough to claim capable general LLM quality.
No model has been trained here. Source text can contain undesirable content; review/filter policies before teaching children or publishing a course pack.
